pages.title: Black Hole Thermodynamics
pages.text: $(thing)Black Hole Thermodynamics$()$(br2)A black hole has a temperature, so it has an entropy - and that entropy is its horizon's area in Planck units, divided by four. The most information any region can hold is set by its surface, not its volume.
$(thing)Insight$(): 260$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Hawking Radiation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Hawking Quanta, 1 Bekenstein Crystal.
